headline: Havertz's close-range finish puts Arsenal on top
description: Kai Havertz pokes home in the 16th minute to deliver the Gunners the decisive goal against Liverpool at Anfield.

headline: Ex-Liverpool, Man City star Milner runs NYC Marathon in just over three hours
description: It's clear James Milner is enjoying his retirement from soccer, as he ran the 2026 NYC Marathon on Sunday with an impressive time. Did we mention he's 40 years old?

headline: Arteta says Arsenal 'loved the mission' in first Anfield win since 2012
description: Mikel Arteta said his players "loved the mission" of winning at Liverpool for the first time in 14 years as he hailed Sunday's "historic" 1-0 victory at Anfield.
